name: Er
overview: Er was a male figure mentioned in the lineage of the Messiah as recorded in Luke 3:28. While his tribal affiliation and additional notes are not specified, his inclusion in this genealogy highlights his role in the ancestral line leading to Christ. There is no further detailed background provided about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Er is a proper name meaning "watchful" or "watcher." This meaning, derived from the original language, suggests attentiveness or vigilance, though the name was not given by God according to the record in Luke 3:28.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Er as the son of Elmadam, an inferred relationship from Luke 3:28, and as the father of Joshua, explicitly stated in Luke 3:29. These relationships place him within a generational sequence in the Messiah's genealogy.
scriptureSignificance: Er's significance lies primarily in his place within the ancestral line of Jesus Christ, underscoring the human lineage through which God fulfilled Messianic prophecy. Although details about his life and deeds are scarce, his mention affirms the historical reality and continuity of Christ's genealogy as presented in the Gospel of Luke.
